source.title: Xenastro's original Dragonflight Prospecting Calculator workbook — accessible Start Here worksheet
source.author: Xenastro

notes: Original author workbook is accessible as Google gviz HTML, but only its Start Here gem-distribution/reference sheet could be retrieved. For example, Eternity Amber quality 2 is 36.43% in the Q2 Serevite Ore gem distribution and 34.02% in the Q2 Draconium Ore distribution. These are reported shares among gem output categories (distribution columns sum to 100%), NOT the chance a material appears in at least one completed prospect, not hit-count fractions and not measured operations. No gold prices were taken. The author's historical Prospecting Log raw rows (including 28/33/39/54/62) were previously researched/imported, so this spreadsheet view is a provenance/interpretation check, not a new independent study or updated measured cohort. Requested Prospecting Log sheet view instead resolved to Start Here in current scraper; actual completed casts, Resourcefulness refunds, distinct rank-specific output IDs and zero-inclusive per-operation yield histograms remain unavailable. No previous original results were recopied and no estimator/production fields altered.
